name: Descriptor Local de Weber
description: Analyzes local intensity changes using Weber's Law principles. AI images show different Weber descriptor distributions than natural photographs.
mechanism: Computes differential excitation and orientation based on Weber's Law. AI-generated textures produce distinct WLD distributions.
useCase: Detecting unnatural texture distributions in AI images

references.title: Chen, J. et al. (2010). WLD: A Robust Local Image Descriptor. IEEE TPAMI.
Weber, E.H. (1834). De Pulsu, Resorptione, Auditu et Tactu. Annotationes Anatomicae.
Fan, K.C. & Hung, T.Y. (2014). A Novel Local Pattern Descriptor — WLD. IEEE TPAMI.

strengths:
• Biologically inspired texture representation
• Based on Weber's law of just-noticeable differences
• Captures both differential excitation and orientation
• Robust to illumination and contrast changes
• Complementary to LBP and GLCM methods
limitations:
• Sensitive to image noise at fine scales
• Quantization parameters affect descriptor quality
• Computationally more expensive than simpler descriptors
• Limited multi-scale analysis in basic form
• AI-generated textures increasingly pass Weber analysis
